request.description:
**GET /examSchedule/availableRooms**

Returns rooms available for room assignment for the given `examScheduleId`.

Each room includes: `roomNumber`, `capacity`, `examCapacity`, `examCapacityColumns`, `effectiveExamCapacity` (`examCapacity` or fallback `capacity`).

Excludes rooms that are:
- Assigned to another overlapping exam on the same date
- Used by a class on that day/time (timetable)
- Already assigned to this exam
- Soft-deleted or under inactive building hierarchy

Response also includes slot info: `examDate`, `examTime`, `duration`, `slotStartTime`, `slotEndTime`, `day`.

**POST /examSchedule/assignRoom**

Assigns rooms to an exam schedule. `classRoomSectionIds` accepts room IDs or `{ classRoomSectionId, orderKey }` objects (order 1..n, no gaps).

Total `effectiveExamCapacity` must be >= enrolled student count. Uses a DB transaction for writes.

Call **GET /examSchedule/availableRooms** first to list conflict-free rooms.

**PUT /examSchedule/roomAssignment**

Updates capacity/columns for an existing room assignment. Uses a DB transaction.

item.description:
Exam date/time scheduling under `/examScheduleMapping`.

**POST /schedule** creates an `exam_schedule` row. `acedmicYearId` is taken from the authenticated user's `defaultAcademicYearId` (not sent in body).

**Student time conflict:** rejects when another exam for the same student cohort (same `sessionId`, academic year, `courseId` + `term` from `examSetupTypeTermId`, and `semesterId` when provided) overlaps on the same `examDate` (`examTime` + `duration`).

request.description:
**POST /examScheduleMapping/schedule**

Creates an exam schedule (date/time slot for a subject).

### Required body
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `examSetupTypeTermId` | Links to course + term |
| `sessionId` | Session for enrolled students |
| `subjectId` | Subject being scheduled |
| `examDate` | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `examTime` | e.g. `10:00:00` |
| `duration` | Minutes as string, e.g. `"120"` |
| `type` | e.g. `Theory` |

Optional: `semesterId` ΓÇö when set, conflict check is scoped to that semester.

### Server-set
- `acedmicYearId` from token user's `defaultAcademicYearId`
- `createdBy` / `updatedBy` from token user

### Conflict rule
Returns **500** with message like:
`Cannot schedule exam: {subjectName} is already scheduled at the same time for the same students`

when another exam overlaps for the same course/term/session cohort.

### Success
**201** ΓÇö `{ message, examSchedule }`. Test script saves `examScheduleId` to `{{examScheduleMapping_examScheduleId}}`.

item.name: library issue book
item.description:
Library issue/return flow under `/libraryIssueBook`.

**Test order:** create ΓåÆ get all/get single ΓåÆ **get inventory issue history** (by `inventoryId`) ΓåÆ update with `returnItems` (partial/full return) ΓåÆ update due date/inventory if needed.

**Rules**
- `memberType`: `STUDENT` | `TEACHER`; `memberId` maps to student/employee PK
- Transaction: `issueDate`, `dueDate` (`dueDate` >= `issueDate`)
- Return is stored in `library_return_book_transaction`; inventory item links via `libraryReturnBookTransactionId`
- Active issue = item row with `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` NULL; same `inventoryId` can be re-issued after return
- For same `returnDate`, one return transaction can be reused for multiple returned items
- `library_book_inventory.status`: `available` ΓåÆ `issued` on issue, back to `available` on return
- `inventoryItems[]` on update replaces outstanding copies (auto-returns old active items)
- `returnItems[]` on update returns selected books by item id or inventory id
- **GET /inventoryIssueHistory?inventoryId=** ΓÇö accession copy + all issue rows for that inventory (nested `bookDetails`, `issueBookTransaction` with `studentMember` / `teacherMember`)

Auth: Bearer {{token}}

request.description:
**POST /libraryIssueBook**

Creates transaction + items (initially `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` is `null`). Sets each `library_book_inventory.status` to `issued`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `memberId`, `memberType` | Yes | STUDENT ΓåÆ student_id, TEACHER ΓåÆ employee_id |
| `issueDate`, `dueDate` | Yes | `dueDate` >= `issueDate` |
| `inventoryItems[]` | No | Copy must be `available`; unique per request |

**GET /libraryIssueBook**

## studentFeePayment (fee v2)

- **dueAmount** = total ΓêÆ paidAmount; reject if amount > dueAmount

## Tables

**GET /studentFeePayment/payment/details?studentId=**

- `totalInvoices` ΓÇö count of generated invoices for this student
- `lastPayment` ΓÇö latest INCOMING payment (`studentFeePaymentId`, `amount`, `paymentMethod`, `paymentDate`) or `null`
- `outstandingAmount` ΓÇö sum of `balanceDue` on unpaid/partial invoices
- `totalPaymentReceived` ΓÇö sum of **payment_item** amounts (INCOMING) across all student invoices

**Per invoice (in `invoices[]`, unpaid/partial only):**
- `total` from **student_fee_invoice_items** (sum amount ΓêÆ waiver)
- `paidAmount` from **payment_item** SUM
- `balanceDue` = total ΓêÆ paidAmount

```json
{
  "payeeId": 2152,
  "payeeType": "STUDENT",
  "amount": "8000.00",
  "paymentItems": [
    { "referenceId": 42, "referenceType": "STUDENT_FEE_INVOICE", "amount": "5000.00" },
```

**Response:** `data.assets[]` each with `totalInventory`, `issuedCount`, `nonIssuedCount`, `inventoryItems[]` (`issueStatus`: `issued` \| `available`), `pagination` (`page`, `limit`, `total`).
**GET /asset/single?assetId=** ΓÇö asset master + `totalInventory`, `issuedCount`, `nonIssuedCount`, `inventoryItems[]` (code, barcode, status, `classRoomSectionId`, `classRoom`).

**PATCH /asset** ΓÇö Same **`inventoryBulk[]`** as POST create. `assetId` required; at least one other field. Body must be strict JSON (no `//` comments).

| Optional | Purpose |
|----------|--------|
| `name`, `condition`, `description`, `assetCategoryId` | Master (`code` read-only) |
| `inventoryBulk[]` | Append copies: each row **`count`** required, **`classRoomSectionId`** optional |

Append-only example: `{ "assetId": 1, "inventoryBulk": [{ "count": 3 }] }`. Does not update existing inventory lines.
**DELETE /asset/inventory?assetInventoryItemId=** ΓÇö 409 if issued and not returned.
**DELETE /asset?assetId=** ΓÇö blocked if inventory exists or items still issued.

item.name: assetIssue
item.description:
## Asset issue / return (all APIs)

**Prerequisite:** **asset ΓåÆ create** first. Use `{{assetInventoryItem_id}}` on issue (must be `NOT_ASSIGNED` or returned).

| # | Method | Path | Notes |
|---|--------|------|--------|
| 1 | POST | `/assetIssue` | Issue; optional `securityAmount` |
| 2 | GET | `/assetIssue` | List ΓÇö no payments |
| 3 | GET | `/assetIssue/single` | One issue ΓÇö includes `securityPayment` if any |
| 4 | GET | `/assetIssue/payments` | Payments for `assetIssueTransactionId` |
| 5 | PATCH | `/assetIssue` | Update member/dates |
| 6 | POST | `/assetIssue/return` | Return lines; optional deposit settlement |
| 7 | GET | `/assetIssue/return` | List returns ΓÇö no payments |
| 8 | GET | `/assetIssue/return/payments` | Return settlement (`assetReturnTransactionId`) |

**Return:** `returnCondition` required per item. `securityAmount` + `fineAmount` must be sent together for settlement. `paymentMethod`: `cash` \| `credit_card` \| `bank_transfer` \| `cheque`.

request.description:
**POST /assetIssue**

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `memberId`, `memberType` | yes | `STUDENT` or `TEACHER` |
| `issueDate`, `dueDate` | yes | `dueDate` >= `issueDate` |
| `items[]` | yes | `{ assetInventoryItemId }` ΓÇö copy must not already be on open issue |
| `securityAmount` | no | Creates `ASSET_SECURITY` payment when set |
| `paymentMethod` | no | Default `cash`; also `credit_card`, `bank_transfer`, `cheque` |

Response: issue row + `items[]` + optional `securityPayment`. Sets `assetIssueTransaction_id`, `assetIssueInventoryItem_id`.
**GET /assetIssue** ΓÇö paginated issues. Each row: `memberBasicDetails`, `issuedTotalItems` (lines on this issue), `returnedTotalItems` (returned lines), `items[]` (no payments).

**GET /assetIssue/payments?assetIssueTransactionId=** ΓÇö payments for one issue.

Response: `memberBasicDetails` (issue member) + `payments[]` each with `payeeDetails` (name, scholarNumber/course for student; employeeName/code for teacher).

`paymentPurpose`: `ASSET_SECURITY` | `RETURN_SETTLEMENT`.

**GET /assetIssue/single?assetIssueTransactionId=** ΓÇö same as list row: `issuedTotalItems`, `returnedTotalItems`, `items[]`, optional `securityPayment`. Use **get issue payments by id** for `payments[]` only.
**PATCH /assetIssue** ΓÇö `assetIssueTransactionId` + optional `memberId`, `memberType`, `issueDate`, `dueDate`. Returns same shape as GET single.

**POST /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö with deposit settlement.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `returnDate` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DD`; >= each line `issueDate` |
| `items[]` | yes | `assetIssueInventoryItemId`, `returnCondition`, optional `damageNotes` |
| `securityAmount`, `fineAmount` | together | Both required to record settlement payment; omit both for return-only (see **return (no settlement)**) |
| `paymentMethod` | no | Default `cash` |

Sets `assetReturnTransaction_id`. Use **get return payments by id** for settlement details.
**POST /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö return only (no `securityAmount` / `fineAmount`). No deposit settlement payment.
**GET /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö `data.assetReturnTransactions[]` (`returnDate`, `items[]`), `pagination`. No payment rows (use **get return payments by id**).

**GET /assetIssue/return/payments?assetReturnTransactionId=** ΓÇö settlement payment(s) for this return only.

Response: `memberBasicDetails` (member from returned lines) + `payments[]` each with `payeeDetails`. Empty `payments[]` if no settlement recorded.

item.name: amcContract
item.description:
## amcContract

**Prerequisite:** **amcVendor → create** (`{{amcVendor_id}}`). One contract per vendor.

`contractNumber` is auto-generated (e.g. `AMC26-0001`) — do **not** send on create.

**Workflow:** DRAFT → **submit for approval** → PUBLISHED → **approve** → APPROVED. Only DRAFT contracts can be updated or deleted.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| POST | `/amcContract` |
| GET | `/amcContract/numberpreview` |
| GET | `/amcContract/summary` |
| POST | `/amcContract/submitforapproval` |
| POST | `/amcContract/approve` |
| GET | `/amcContract?page&limit&search&approvalStatus&status` |
| GET | `/amcContract/single?amcContractId=` |
| PATCH | `/amcContract` |
| DELETE | `/amcContract?amcContractId=` |

request.description:
**POST /amcContract** — create contract in `DRAFT` approval status.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `contractName` | yes | |
| `amcVendorId` | yes | From **amcVendor** |
| `contractType` | yes | `COMPREHENSIVE_AMC`, `NON_COMPREHENSIVE_AMC`, `WARRANTY_AMC`, `PREVENTIVE_MAINTENANCE`, `ON_DEMAND_SERVICE` |
| `startDate`, `endDate` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DD`; `endDate` >= `startDate` |
| `contractValue` | yes | string or number |
| `paymentTerms` | yes | `ANNUAL_UPFRONT`, `QUARTERLY`, `MONTHLY` |
| `serviceVisitFrequency` | yes | `MONTHLY`, `QUARTERLY`, `ANNUALLY` |
| `slaResponseHours` | yes | `2`, `6`, `12`, `24`, `48`, `72` |
| `slaResolutionHours` | yes | `6`, `12`, `24`, `48`, `72` |
| `description` | no | |

Sets `{{amcContract_id}}`.
**GET /amcContract/numberpreview** — read-only preview of next `contractNumber` (e.g. `AMC26-0001`). Does not reserve the number.
**GET /amcContract/summary** — dashboard counts: `totalContracts`, `totalContractsValue`, `activeContracts`, `nearExpiryContracts`, `expiredContracts`.
**POST /amcContract/submitforapproval** — `amcContractId` in body. Only `DRAFT` → `PUBLISHED`.
**POST /amcContract/approve** — `amcContractId` in body. Only `PUBLISHED` → `APPROVED`.

query.description: Optional. Contract name, number, or vendor name
Optional expiry filter. ACTIVE | NEAR_EXPIRY | EXPIRED

request.description:
**GET /amcContract** — paginated list with optional `approvalStatus` and expiry `status` filters.

**Response:** `data.rows[]`, `data.total`, `data.page`, `data.limit`.
**GET /amcContract/single?amcContractId=** — full contract with vendor details.

**PATCH /amcContract** — `amcContractId` required; at least one updatable field. Only `DRAFT` contracts.

Cannot change `amcVendorId` or `contractNumber`.
**DELETE /amcContract?amcContractId=** — only `DRAFT` contracts.

item.name: amcServiceTicket
item.description:
## amcServiceTicket

**Prerequisite:** **asset → create** (`{{asset_id}}`). Optional: **amcVendor** (`{{amcVendor_id}}`) — if omitted, vendor is auto-resolved from the asset's category when available.

`ticketNumber` is auto-generated (e.g. `TKT-2026-001`) — do **not** send on create.

**Rules:** Only `OPEN` tickets can be deleted. Non-status field updates require `OPEN` status (unless `status` is included in the same PATCH). `CLOSED` tickets cannot be modified.

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| POST | `/serviceTicket` |
| GET | `/serviceTicket/numberpreview` |
| GET | `/serviceTicket/summary` |
| GET | `/serviceTicket?page&limit&search&status&priority&amcVendorId` |
| GET | `/serviceTicket/single?serviceTicketId=` |
| PATCH | `/serviceTicket` |
| DELETE | `/serviceTicket?serviceTicketId=` |

body.raw:
{
  "assetId": {{asset_id}},
  "amcVendorId": {{amcVendor_id}},
  "issue": "Laptop not booting",
  "issueType": "HARDWARE",
  "problemDescription": "Device powers on but shows black screen after logo.",
  "downtimeStartedAt": "2026-06-08T10:30:00+05:30",
  "priority": "HIGH"
}

request.description:
**POST /serviceTicket** — raise AMC service ticket (status `OPEN`).

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `assetId` | yes | From **asset** |
| `issue` | yes | Short title |
| `issueType` | yes | `HARDWARE`, `SOFTWARE` |
| `problemDescription` | yes | max 1000 chars |
| `downtimeStartedAt` | yes | ISO 8601 datetime with offset |
| `amcVendorId` | no | Omit or `null` to auto-resolve from asset category |
| `priority` | no | `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, `CRITICAL` (default `MEDIUM`) |

Do **not** send `ticketNumber` or `status`. Sets `{{serviceTicket_id}}`.

**GET /serviceTicket/numberpreview** — read-only preview of next `ticketNumber` (e.g. `TKT-2026-001`). Does not reserve the number.

**Response:** `ticketNumber`, `year`.
**GET /serviceTicket/summary** — dashboard counts: `openTickets`, `assignedTickets`, `inProgressTickets`, `escalatedTickets`, `resolvedMtd`.

query.description: Optional. Ticket number, issue, description, asset name/code, vendor name/code
Optional. OPEN | ASSIGNED | IN_PROGRESS | ESCALATED | RESOLVED | CLOSED

request.description:
**GET /serviceTicket** — paginated list.

| Query | Default |
|-------|--------|
| `page` | 1 |
| `limit` | 20 (max 100) |
| `search` | optional |
| `status` | optional |
| `priority` | optional |
| `amcVendorId` | optional |

**Response:** `data.rows[]`, `data.total`, `data.page`, `data.limit`. Rows include `assetName`, `assetCode`, `vendorName`, `vendorCode`, `assetCategoryName`.
**GET /serviceTicket/single?serviceTicketId=** — ticket with asset, vendor, and category details.

**PATCH /serviceTicket** — `serviceTicketId` required; at least one of `issue`, `issueType`, `problemDescription`, `downtimeStartedAt`, `priority`, `status`, `amcVendorId`.

`status`: `OPEN`, `ASSIGNED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `ESCALATED`, `RESOLVED`, `CLOSED`.

Non-status updates allowed only on `OPEN` tickets. `CLOSED` tickets cannot be modified.
**DELETE /serviceTicket?serviceTicketId=** — only `OPEN` tickets.
